raw:
The 2009 German Grand Prix was held at the Nürburgring on 12 July 2009 (round 9 of the season), and the race report lists Mark Webber of Red Bull as the winner, starting from pole position. Sebastian Vettel was second and Felipe Massa third.

ANSWER: Mark Webber
